_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 2653916f: the aggregation step of SPARQL 1.1 (§18.2.4.1 grouping, §18.2.4.2 HAVING) — GROUP BY over an empty input has no group, HAVING without grouping is a Filter, an aggregate in ORDER BY groups the level, EXISTS works in HAVING and SELECT expressions. Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct across the four specs of this harness). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › <axis> ` (ITRV §A44/§A104). C1–C3 are controls; A12 and A18 lock unchanged behaviour and are green on the pre-fix engine by construction. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145).

M1_explicit_empty_guard_off._note: The guard for GROUP BY over an empty input is gone. With a GROUP BY variable groupSolutions still finds no group, so only GROUP BY by an expression (variables empty, 38328fcc) falls into the implicit single group: one phantom row again.

M2_empty_input_never_groups._note: Plausible over-fix: an empty input never yields a row — the implicit group of an aggregate without GROUP BY (COUNT(*) = 0, w3c agg-empty-group-count-2) is lost too.

M17_explicit_guard_requires_aggregate._note: Review X3: the guard rewritten from the old createEmptyAggregateResult also asks for an aggregate — GROUP BY by an expression with HAVING and no aggregate over an empty input builds the phantom group again (A2c).

M22_both_empty_guards_off._note: Spec stage (axis coverage, §A159): A1 is guarded TWICE — the explicit-GROUP-BY early return AND the deleted fallback group — so neither M1 (guard off) nor restoring the fallback alone turns it red (defensive pair, ITRV §A43). This mutant breaks BOTH in one anchor: no early return, and an empty row whenever no group formed (the 17.18.1 phantom). Expect set measured by the driver.
